request.subject: PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a stone-age war raft: the hull becomes tied logs of warm tawny wood, colour #a2804b; the bow becomes a plesiosaur head painted deep blue #205794 with bold orange stripes; the grey castles become hide huts; the red sails become dull sandy brown animal hide, colour #a67c3d, with big bold dark brown spots; the pennants become orange feathers. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
